app.title: Scale Calculator
app.subtitle: Turn map-distance ÷ real-distance into a ruler you can drag and measure
mode.hint: Pick what to solve; the blue card is the answer
input.title: Given
input.dragHint: Drag the slider or type a number — everything updates live
result.title: Result
forms.title: Three ways to write a scale
forms.verbalTpl: 1 cm on the map = {0} on the ground
steps.title: Worked solution
steps.1.unify: ① Unify units: convert the real distance to cm (1 km = 100000 cm)
steps.2.formulaReal: ② Real distance = map distance × scale denominator
steps.2.formulaMap: ② Map distance = real distance ÷ scale denominator
steps.2.formulaScale: ② Scale denominator = real distance ÷ map distance
steps.5.convert: ⑤ Convert to a sensible unit (cm → m → km)
grade.title: Large / small scale
grade.largeNote: Small area · detailed · e.g. campus plan
grade.smallNote: Large area · simplified · e.g. world map
grade.rule: Bigger denominator → smaller scale → larger area → less detail
pit.title: Common mistakes
pit.1: ① Forgetting to unify units: km ×100000 = cm
pit.3: ③ Don't swap map distance and real distance
field.title: Real-world ruler · how long on the map
field.hint: Pick a real distance and change the scale to see its map length
quiz.title: Practice
quiz.promptReal: Scale 1:{0}, map distance {1} cm — what is the real distance? (enter the number in the shown unit)
quiz.promptMap: Scale 1:{0}, real distance {1} — what is the map distance in cm?
quiz.promptScale: {0} cm on the map = {1} on the ground — what is the scale denominator?
ruler.title: Visual ruler
ruler.realBar: Real distance (compressed by the same scale)
ruler.hint: Blue is the real map length; green is the same real distance compressed by the scale
ruler.overflowMap: This map distance overflows the sheet — use a smaller scale
ruler.overflowReal: This real distance won't fit at this scale — use a smaller scale
common.footer: Scale = map distance ÷ real distance  ·  unify units first  ·  bigger denominator = smaller scale
